_meta.description: NSE corporate-announcement evidence candidates for Big Move Scanner.
_meta.important: Strong NSE CAPEX evidence may be AUTO_VERIFIED. Ambiguous CAPEX and all Tailwind evidence remain REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.capex: Requires explicit company-specific capacity, plant, facility, commissioning or production-expansion evidence.
rules.negativeCapex: Postponed, delayed, deferred, cancelled, suspended, shutdown, closure and similar negative events are rejected before positive keyword matching.
rules.deduplication: Repeated filings are reduced to the strongest/latest useful candidate for each company.
rules.tailwind: Requires an explicit structural driver such as PLI, import substitution, localisation, China+1, policy or regulatory change.
rules.scoreRule: CAPEX score or Tailwind score alone does NOT create a Big Move trigger.

capex.reason: Commissioning / Commercial Operations. Commencement of commercial production/operations
